articles.title: CBSE Class 12 supplementary exam 2026 announced; Schools asked to submit LOC by July 8
articles.summary: CBSE has announced the Class 12 supplementary examination for the year 2026. This is a crucial update for students aiming to improve their scores or clear backlogs. Schools have been instructed to submit the List of Candidates (LOC) by July 8. Aspiring candidates should ensure timely submission through their respective schools to participate in these upcoming examinations, highlighting the importance of adherence to academic deadlines.

articles.title: Defence Investment Plan - Oral Statement
articles.summary: A parliamentary statement was made outlining the Defence Investment Plan, underscoring the vital role of the Armed Forces, including sailors safeguarding regions like the High North. This initiative details future strategic investments and spending priorities crucial for modernising national defence capabilities and ensuring effective equipment for service personnel, reinforcing the government's commitment to security.
